positions.name: ProShares UltraPro Short QQQ (3X Inverse Nasdaq-100)
positions.sector: Broad US Tech (3x Inverse Leveraged ETF)
positions.catalyst: A broad semiconductor/memory ROUT is the dominant fresh catalyst on today's tape. SK Hynix closed -11.5% in Seoul (reversing yesterday's +8%), Samsung -8%, Advantest -5.93%, Tokyo Electron -4%, Renesas -7%, SoftBank -6.27%; memory stocks (MU/Samsung/Hynix) have been dragged into a bear market on AI-capex-digestion fears. US pre-market confirms the spillover: SMH -2.8% (590.77->574.36), NVDA -1.6% (212.50->208.98), Micron ~-6%, SOXL (3x semis) -10.5%. This is compounded by a HAWKISH Warsh ('no tolerance for persistently elevated inflation') and a stalling two-day rally — the July 16 Polymarket contract implies only 37% chance the S&P opens higher. QQQ -0.85% pre-market. SQQQ live 39.95x39.96 (Robinhood pre-market 11:42Z), +2.6% — NOT extended.
positions.driver: Playing the chip-led risk-off with a 3x INVERSE on the broad Nasdaq rather than the pure-semis inverse. Direction is short/bearish: the memory bear market + hawkish Fed + failing rally point down, and QQQ is only -0.85% pre-market vs semis already -3%, so the broad index has ROOM to catch down to the chip complex during the cash session — an asymmetric setup. 3x is justified by a strong, fresh, multi-name catalyst (an entire sector entering a bear market plus a hawkish central-bank signal). Choosing SQQQ over the thematically-purer SOXS specifically to AVOID chasing: SOXS is already +9.6% pre-market (right at the >8-10% no-chase band), whereas SQQQ at +2.6% offers a clean, unextended entry with built-in diversification across the Nasdaq-100. RUNNERS-UP: SOXS (3x inverse semis) rejected as a chase at +9.6% — best thematic fit but the gap is already made and 3x inverse into an exhausted down-move risks a violent dip-buy reversal. SOXL (3x long semis) rejected — buying a falling knife down 10% into a bear-market rout is the exact trap. PYPL (+18% on a $53B Stripe/Advent buyout rumor) rejected — up far beyond the no-chase band and rumor-reversal risk. SPXL/TQQQ long rejected — wrong side of a risk-off tape. BITX (2x BTC) rejected — flat/no catalyst.
positions.risks: This is a leveraged SHORT into an already-down gap, so the primary risk is a 'washout bottom' bounce: Benzinga is already framing the memory slump as a 'prime AI memory entry point' and the selloff as profit-taking, so dip-buyers could reverse the tape green intraday and 3x inverse amplifies that against me. Secondary risk: a benign PPI/retail-sales read or dovish Fed-speak reignites the risk-on trade that dominated the last two sessions. The Nasdaq's diversification cuts both ways — if only memory bleeds while mega-cap software/AI holds, QQQ may not follow semis down. Hard stop 35.96 (-10% on the 3x, ~ +3.3% QQQ rally) as a disaster stop that only trips on a genuine risk-on reversal, not intraday chop.
